products.name: Synthetic Data Governance for Regulated Healthcare (HIPAA/HITRUST + Enterprise Data Governance) — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish synthetic data governance for regulated healthcare — policy, catalog/lineage, approval, access, aligned to HIPAA/HITRUST + enterprise data governance — so the capability scales without shadow risk. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Govern synthetic data like the regulated asset it is

Even synthetic data needs governance in a regulated healthcare enterprise — lineage, approval, access, and alignment to HIPAA/HITRUST and enterprise data-governance standards. This solution establishes synthetic data governance: the policies, catalog/lineage, approval workflow, access model, and controls that make synthetic and test data managed, auditable, and aligned to regulated-data constraints — so the capability scales without becoming a shadow risk.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python tooling.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the synthetic-data governance model: policy, catalog/lineage, classification, approval, access, and how it aligns to HIPAA/HITRUST + enterprise data governance.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (governance/compliance stakeholders, catalog tooling, classification scheme, policy).
  • Implementation Guide — define the governance policy + roles, stand up catalog/lineage and classification for synthetic/test assets, wire approval + access controls, and validate against the standards, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
  • Testing/validation gates (assets cataloged, approvals enforced, aligned) plus Best Practices; regulatory interpretation deferred to compliance/legal.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Synthetic and test data managed as governed, auditable assets — cataloged, classified, approved, and access-controlled, aligned to HIPAA/HITRUST — so the capability scales safely.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • assess_governance_readiness.py — profile the current state of synthetic-data governance
    • asset_catalog_register.py — register synthetic/test assets into the catalog with lineage
    • classify_approve_tracker.py — record stewarded classifications and drive the approval workflow
    • control_compliance_check.py — governance gate coverage + control-map evidence view
    • syngov_config.py — scaffold and validate the synthetic-data governance register store

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
